case_observation_unlink_ck.name: case_observation_unlink_ck
case_observation_unlink_ck.value: "case_observation_links"."unlinked_at" IS NULL OR ("case_observation_links"."unlinked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "case_observation_links"."unlinked_at" >= "case_observation_links"."linked_at")

observations_observed_reason_ck.name: observations_observed_reason_ck
observations_observed_reason_ck.value: "observations"."observed_at" IS NOT NULL OR nullif(btrim("observations"."unknown_observed_time_reason"), '') IS NOT NULL

observations_location_reason_ck.name: observations_location_reason_ck
observations_location_reason_ck.value: "observations"."latitude" IS NOT NULL OR nullif(btrim("observations"."location_unknown_reason"), '') IS NOT NULL

case_transition_events_approved_edges_ck.name: case_transition_events_approved_edges_ck
case_transition_events_approved_edges_ck.value:
(
        ("case_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-010' AND "case_transition_events"."from_status" = 'received' AND "case_transition_events"."to_status" = 'under_review' AND "case_transition_events"."task_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("case_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-011' AND "case_transition_events"."from_status" = 'under_review' AND "case_transition_events"."to_status" = 'awaiting_decision' AND "case_transition_events"."task_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("case_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-012' AND "case_transition_events"."from_status" = 'awaiting_decision' AND "case_transition_events"."to_status" = 'monitoring' AND "case_transition_events"."task_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("case_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-013' AND "case_transition_events"."from_status" = 'awaiting_decision' AND "case_transition_events"."to_status" = 'assigned' AND "case_transition_events"."task_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

evidence_media_available_metadata_ck.name: evidence_media_available_metadata_ck
evidence_media_available_metadata_ck.value: "evidence_media"."availability" <> 'available' OR ("evidence_media"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_media"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$' AND "evidence_media"."mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("evidence_media"."mime_type")) > 0 AND "evidence_media"."byte_length" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_media"."byte_length" > 0)

evidence_upload_requests_state_ck.name: evidence_upload_requests_state_ck
evidence_upload_requests_state_ck.value:
(
        (
          "evidence_upload_requests"."status" = 'processing'
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."media_id" IS NULL
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "evidence_upload_requests"."status" = 'completed'
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."media_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."lease_token" IS NULL
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "evidence_upload_requests"."status" = 'failed'
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."media_id" IS NULL
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."lease_token" IS NULL
          AND "evidence_upload_requests"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL
        )
      )

task_assignments_unassign_ck.name: task_assignments_unassign_ck
task_assignments_unassign_ck.value: "task_assignments"."unassigned_at" IS NULL OR ("task_assignments"."unassigned_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_assignments"."unassigned_at" >= "task_assignments"."assigned_at")

task_transition_events_approved_edge_ck.name: task_transition_events_approved_edge_ck
task_transition_events_approved_edge_ck.value:
(
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-024' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'assigned' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'accepted') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-025' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'accepted' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'in_progress') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-026' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'in_progress' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'blocked') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-027' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'blocked' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'in_progress') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-028' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'in_progress' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'submitted') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-029' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'submitted' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'completed') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-030' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'submitted' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'in_progress') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-031' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'assigned' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'cancelled') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-032' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'in_progress' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'cancelled') OR
      ("task_transition_events"."transition_id" = 'AB-TR-033' AND "task_transition_events"."from_status" = 'blocked' AND "task_transition_events"."to_status" = 'cancelled')
    )

report_versions_one_current_published_uq.name: report_versions_one_current_published_uq
report_versions_one_current_published_uq.where: "report_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "report_versions"."superseded_at" IS NULL

report_versions_publication_order_ck.name: report_versions_publication_order_ck
report_versions_publication_order_ck.value: "report_versions"."superseded_at" IS NULL OR ("report_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "report_versions"."superseded_at" >= "report_versions"."published_at")
